svg.title: HybridGuard: choose checks and check current data
svg.desc: An editable two-band system diagram. Normal and modified development records feed filtering, selection, refinement, and saved checks. Current App records and optional linked Browser input feed evaluation. Illustrations show a 3 GiB device giving a 4 GiB memory limit, an 8 GiB Web value exceeding it, and matching or mismatching effective timezone offsets. Results are alert, no alert, or cannot tell, with separate no-checks and check-failed states. Logos and values are illustrative.
